comparisonPanel_previous_result_update_f: This is the previous result. Preserves previous values ​​even during update or failed state.
comparisonPanel_amount_case_link_allocat: The amount shown may differ from the total amount of the original transaction at work based on the payments linked and allocated to this statement. comparisonPanel_previous_result_current_: Preserves previous inquiry results. Currentness could not be confirmed.
comparisonPanel_deposit_comparison_resul: There are no deposit verification results.
duplicateCandidates_amount_payment_trans: Compare transactions recorded with the same date, amount, and payment method. It does not merge or delete automatically.
paymentScreen_transaction_workplace_all_: The original transaction is shared across the workplace. Release of distribution and deletion of original transaction are different. It may also affect other payments.
paymentScreen_allocation_all_amount_coun: It cannot be lowered than the full amount already distributed.
paymentScreen_current_transaction_alloca: In case of a conflict, please check the latest transactions and distributions and re-examine your entries.
paymentScreen_create_transaction_empty_p: There are no registered transactions. This does not mean that the payment amount is 0 won.
paymentScreen_case_allocation_release: Should we just release the distribution of this information?
paymentScreen_transaction_delete_impact_: Check the impact of deleting the original transaction
paymentScreen_transaction_all_allocation: Transaction #{value1}: Total distribution of {value2} won. Other distributions may also be eliminated. The full impact cannot be determined from current inquiries alone.
paymentScreen_impact_case_allocation_res: Impact breakdown returned by the server: {value1}. Distribution by breakdown is not provided in this response.
unavailableCandidate: Required information or provenance needs review.
candidateRegistered: Transaction registered. Verify the transaction below, then save the Case allocation.
optionalConnections: Payment connections are optional. Transactions are shared within the workplace; allocations belong to each Case.
